name: pmstudio-arb
description: Generate an Architecture Review Board (ARB) presentation in a standard 11-slide format. Use when someone asks to "create an ARB deck", "architecture review presentation", "prepare for architecture review board", "ARB slides", or needs to present a product/platform architecture for sign-off. Reads PRD, architecture maps, and project memory to pre-fill technical content. Produces a self-contained HTML slide deck.
